title: Poor billing at Chez Maurice and suing Nazarro for $150,000
summary: With no publicity sent to the Canadian theatre, he goes back to New York and files suit against Nazarro for neglect of management.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Managers, bookers and the business of getting work

blocks.x: You got Chez Maurice? The Chez Maurice at which time the billing for Buck and Bubbles was so nil from the lack of management supervision for publicity to be sent to the theater for our appearance that it hurt me in such an extent -- to such an extent that I wanted to make a reason to get out of the contract. Make this sufficient enough to get out of the contract.

So I go back to New York from Canada after learning that he hadn't sent no publicity concerning Buck and Bubbles that we could get any recognition on billing or anything and that time I think it was Sally Rand was the
headline act on the bill and I had to find what other acts were on the bill before that and what kind of billing they got and all and see what Buck and Bubbles would be rated.
However, I get back in New York and I get a lawyer and I file action against Nazarro for $150,000 for neglectment of management.
This was only a few years after you first got associated with him?
No, no, this was -- how you mean the first year?
This is when you were about 24 --
I just left the Pathe' studio, didn't I? That must be about 1921. I didn't get to '22 yet, because '22 is different. So back in '21 --
So I found a lawyer in New York and presented my case to him
